issues.title: Stage run IDs are caller labels rather than verified properties of producer inputs
issues.affected: V551, V551J, V552, V552J stage boundaries and manifests
issues.defect: Several compilers accept arbitrary `--run-id`/root paths without proving that embedded producer run IDs and source scope are singular and equal. V551 can write run B from bridge rows identifying run A; V551J can combine V551 and V550J outputs that share source/wave/country but not upstream V550 run; V552/V552J likewise do not consistently bind embedded producer identity to directory run ID.
issues.evidence: Cross-stage run-identity trace during exhaustive audit.
issues.consequence: Even perfectly run-ID-scoped directories do not establish lineage; individually valid artifacts from distinct executions can be fused under one output run label.
issues.required: Make producer-run identity and source/wave/country/shard scope explicit, singular, and verified at every stage boundary. Output run identity must be derived/bound to producer identity, not merely trusted from CLI naming.
tests: Mixed producer run IDs are rejected before semantic joins.
CLI run ID mismatch with embedded producer identity is a typed integrity failure.

issues.title: Producer-declared failure/integrity is not binding on downstream consumption
issues.defect: Consumers often validate path existence or table shape but do not require a successful producer integrity/readiness state plus producer-declared artifact hash and compatible contract version. V550J can report `failed_validation` yet still exit 0; V551J reads the report but does not gate on it. Similar weak binding exists for V551 atoms into V552 and V551J/V552 inputs into V552J.
issues.evidence: Producer/consumer boundary trace and existing tautological/self-hash findings.
issues.consequence: A producer that explicitly declared itself invalid—or a substituted/stale artifact with plausible columns—can become semantic input downstream.
issues.required: Standardize every boundary on: producer run integrity PASS, exact producer-declared artifact-file hash, supported contract version, and exact run/scope identity. Shape validation is additional, not a substitute.
tests: Failed producer run cannot feed downstream semantic compilation.
Tampered/substituted artifact with valid-looking schema fails producer hash verification.

issues.title: Lineage resolver can select V550J from a different run than V550/V551
issues.defect: The resolver selects a V550 shard and derives its run ID, but chooses V550J independently with a broad source-wave/mtime search rather than requiring the selected V550 run ID. V551 onward are then tied back to the V550 run.
issues.consequence: A certified lineage can splice a joint-evidence stage from a different execution into the V550/V551/V552 chain.
issues.required: Select all run-coupled stages from the same verified producer-run identity. Never use independent newest-by-mtime selection for a stage participating in one lineage.
tests: Candidate lineage with mismatched V550/V550J run IDs is rejected.
Resolver selects one coherent run graph, not per-stage newest files.

issues.title: Dead V552 architecture still defines required artifacts in live lineage/preflight
issues.affected: resolve_pipeline_lineage.py; compile_v5_paired_wave_preflight.py vs effective V552 compiler
issues.defect: Live consumers require `manifest/v552_input_provenance_manifest.json`, but the effective V552 compiler does not write it; that artifact belongs to the shadowed/dead earlier V552 builder architecture.
issues.evidence: Producer/consumer artifact-name closure across effective V552 builder, lineage resolver, and paired-wave preflight.
issues.consequence: A correct live V552 run can be rejected for omitting an artifact that no live producer creates; dead architecture continues to govern orchestration.
issues.required: Remove/replace ghost artifact requirements everywhere with the current versioned V552 producer manifest and producer-declared hashes. Search the entire active consumer surface for the old artifact name.
tests: Fresh effective V552 output satisfies lineage and paired-wave preflight without legacy ghost files.
No active consumer requires `v552_input_provenance_manifest.json` unless a compatibility adapter actually produces it.

issues.title: Unreadable or missing readiness status fails open
issues.affected: resolve_pipeline_lineage.py readiness parsing and candidate usability
issues.defect: The resolver only rejects a non-ready candidate when it successfully parses a nonempty status string. Corrupt/unparseable readiness yields blank status during gating and can be returned usable with status `unknown`. One V552 path also points the JSON status reader at a Parquet file.
issues.evidence: Constructed malformed readiness JSON with require_ready=True returned usable=True/status=unknown; static trace found V552 readiness Parquet/JSON mismatch.
issues.consequence: Corrupt status metadata is treated more permissively than an honest BLOCKED status, allowing failed/unverifiable producers into the lineage.
issues.required: Required producer readiness/integrity must fail closed when missing, unreadable, wrong format, or unknown for the declared contract version. Parse typed manifest enums; legacy adapters must be explicit.
tests: Malformed required readiness file is unusable.
Wrong-format status path is detected as integrity failure, not `unknown` usability.
